acceptanceCriteria: A test asserts gitDeadline == 10*time.Second by literal; a mutation of the constant fails it.
The source-deadline pin runs on Windows too (or a Windows-specific pin exists), verified by GOOS=windows vet and a CI run.
body: Residual from the V1-0969/V1-1398 cmd/corvint flakes lane (PR #921, branch claude/cmd-flakes-0969-1398, head 38668fbc9, base 55b0c0f09; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores). (1) internal/gokernel/repository_test.go:237 derives its expectation from gitDeadline itself, so nothing pins the 10 s probe bound independently (Codex P3, predates #921). (2) TestSourceDeadlineReplacesFrozenBound runs only on darwin and linux, so the expand sequence bound's 10 s production value is unpinned on Windows.
title: pin the 10 s gokernel gitDeadline by literal value and pin the context --expand 10 s source deadline on Windows
